query:
SELECT a.id, a.title, a.isVip, a.freePreviewCount, 
       COUNT(p.id) as total_photos,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.isFreePreview = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as free_preview_photos
FROM albums a
LEFT JOIN photos p ON p.albumId = a.id
WHERE a.isVip = 1
GROUP BY a.id, a.title, a.isVip, a.freePreviewCount
LIMIT 10;
